The '''fusion bomb''' was a type of powerful [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]] produced around [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. The effects of the [[gravity bomb]]s displayed during the [[Battle of Mindor]] were comparable to the fusion bomb's.<ref name="Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>
